## Beta — Lane layout

Rules that overlap in time are now shown **side by side** in the weekly card instead of stacking on top of each other and hiding one another.

- Overlapping blocks in the same day are grouped and each one gets its own lane; the width of the group is split between the lanes in use.
- A chain of rules that only overlap partially (A overlaps B, B overlaps C, but A and C don't) reuses free lanes, so it never takes more columns than needed.
- Rules that don't overlap, or that only touch (one ends exactly when the next begins), keep the full width.
- Works together with overnight and multi-day slots, with the optimistic "pending" blocks shown while saving, and when the card is resized.

README roadmap updated: next up are export/import of rules and an optional validity period.
